en.title: Maximum Serial Throughput Within Budget
en.description:
Scaling service i up x times costs x×cost[i] and changes its throughput to base[i]×(1+x), where x is a non-negative integer. The throughput of a serial pipeline is the minimum over all services. Find the maximum throughput within the total budget.

This site has made the standard input and output explicit; any range not given by the source is marked as this site's protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n budget, the second line contains base, and the third line contains cost. The source gives no numeric ranges; on this site 1≤n≤100000, 1≤base[i],cost[i]≤10⁹, 0≤budget≤10⁹.
en.explanation: Example 1: with no budget, the bottleneck is 2. Example 2: throughput 4 needs a budget of 10; throughput 5 needs 22, which exceeds 20, so the maximum is 4, and the budget does not have to be spent completely. Example 3: at most two scale-ups, giving throughput 3×3=9.
hints: Binary search the target throughput T. Service i needs at least ceil(T/base[i])−1 scale-ups; sum the minimum costs one by one, and if the total exceeds the budget, T is infeasible.
